entries.text: Hello, class! It is I, Hassel, yet again.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_05_dragon_01

entries.text: I’m pleased to say that everybody did very well\non the midterm exams.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_05_dragon_02

entries.text: As a reward for all of your hard work, we have\na special guest visiting us today![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_05_dragon_03

entries.text: Now then, Brassie, please come in![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_05_dragon_04

entries.text: Greetings![VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_01

entries.text: I am Brassius. I am an artist, and I focus\nexclusively on Grass-type Pokémon for my work.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_02

entries.text: Brassius here mainly creates three-dimensional\npieces, such as statues and the like.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_05_dragon_05

entries.text: One of his major works is the installation titled\nSurrendering Sunflora, found in Artazon.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_05_dragon_06

entries.text: Many of you who’ve challenged the Artazon Gym\nare no doubt familiar with these sculptures.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_05_dragon_07

entries.text: Yes...I do recognize some faces among your\nstudents.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_03

entries.text: I hope you all understand how fortunate you are\nto be able to attend Hass’s classes.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_04

entries.text: Ol’ Hass is the man who saved me when I had\nlost all hope and given up on myself.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_05

entries.text: But he never gave up on me. I do not exaggerate\nwhen I say that he is my mentor in life![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_06

entries.text: It is precisely thanks to Hass that I was able to\nestablish my current art style.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_07

entries.text: Ah, dear Brassie![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_05_dragon_08

entries.text: I’ve nothing against reminiscing about old times,\nbut today, I hope you will guide this class in a\r\nway only you can![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_05_dragon_09

entries.text: Of course![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_08

entries.text: Let’s see... Ah, why don’t we discuss what Hass\nmentioned—Surrendering Sunflora?[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_09

entries.text: Can anyone here tell what my mood was when I\ncrafted its detached expression?[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_10

entries.text: A happy mood
entries.label: class_f_05_select_01

entries.text: A sad mood
entries.label: class_f_05_select_02

entries.text: An angry mood
entries.label: class_f_05_select_03

entries.text: No, no, no... Completely and utterly wrong![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_11

entries.text: When I made that sculpture, I had surrendered\nall hope. I was prepared to give up everything.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_12

entries.text: I had resolved to give up my life as an artist if\nthat piece did not receive proper recognition.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_13

entries.text: Hence the name Surrendering Sunflora?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_05_dragon_10

entries.text: That’s exactly it, Hass![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_14

entries.text: When I started out as an artist, I experienced\nmany hardships. I even became deathly ill and\r\nfell into a slump that drove me to desperation.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_15

entries.text: I began worrying only about what would sell.\nI was concerned only with fame and fortune...[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_16

entries.text: But all of my pieces during this time had no\ndepth. They were all shallow trash![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_17

entries.text: It was then that I met Hass. He helped me realize\nhow petty I was being. I’ll spare you the details...\r\nbut in the end I was able to leave all that behind![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_18

entries.text: And that is also when I crafted the Sunflora![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_19

entries.text: Remarkable! Even I did not know the full story\nuntil now![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_05_dragon_11

entries.text: This kind of thing is hard to tell someone,\nespecially when they are so close to you.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_20

entries.text: Now, I don’t doubt that you adolescents will\noften find your heads crowded with worries.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_21

entries.text: My advice to you is simple. Be honest with\nyourself, and do whatever your heart desires.\r\n...So long as you don’t cause trouble, that is.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_22

entries.text: That is all from me.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_23

entries.text: I must admit I am beginning to feel a bit\nembarrassed, so I bid you farewell, Hass!\r\nAnd farewell to your pupils as well![VAR 0x0114(0017)]
entries.label: class_f_05_kusa_24

entries.text: Oh Brassie, I can’t believe it... Such a wonderful...\nclass... Thank...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_05_dragon_12

entries.text: THANGYU SO MUBCH![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_05_dragon_13

entries.text: BWUUUH huh huh huh huh!\nHUUUH huh hoi hoi hoi...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
entries.label: class_f_05_dragon_14
